name: Sonic Youth

whyMatters.en: NYC noise-rock band that treated alternate tunings and prepared guitar as composition method; Daydream Nation (1988) is the double-album peak.
whyMatters.zh: 纽约噪音摇滚乐队：把另调弦与预制吉他当作曲方法；Daydream Nation（1988）是双专峰值。

note.zh: Daydream Nation 开场；另调弦圣歌。

note.en: Goo-era; Gordon vocal + Chuck D cameo.
note.zh: Goo 时期；Gordon 人声 + Chuck D 客串。
Sister 时期不协和吉他架构。

interviewQuotes.text: The tuning is the song before the song.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Thurston Moore

lyricQuotes: It is an anthem for the kids of today
Kool thing sitting with a butt like that

shortBio.en: Alternate-tuning noise/indie; Daydream Nation peak; shoegaze-adjacent textures.
shortBio.zh: 另调弦噪音/indie；Daydream Nation 峰值；与 shoegaze 相邻的纹理。

body.en:
Formed 1981. No Wave roots into Sister/Daydream Nation. Moore/Ranaldo alternate tunings, drumsticks under strings, feedback as harmony. Goo/Dirty major-label chapter; end 2011.

Narrative mentions noise and shoegaze adjacency; genre slugs stay alternative/indie-rock.
body.zh:
1981 年组建。从 No Wave 根走到 Sister/Daydream Nation。Moore/Ranaldo 另调弦、弦下鼓棒、反馈当和声。Goo/Dirty 大厂章节；2011 结束。

叙事提及噪音与 shoegaze 相邻；类型 slug 仍是 alternative/indie-rock。

body.en:
Sonic Youth write by retuning first. Prepared guitar and feedback replace blues solo default. Songs still have hooks—noise is method, not only chaos.

Bridge from No Wave to 90s alternative radio.
body.zh:
Sonic Youth 先改调再写。预制吉他与反馈替换蓝调独奏默认。歌仍有钩子——噪音是方法，不只是混乱。

从 No Wave 到 90 年代 alternative 电台的桥。

body.en:
Shelley locks drums mid-80s. Peak: Moore / Gordon / Ranaldo / Shelley on Daydream Nation–Dirty. O'Rourke later expands textures.

Peak flag on late-80s four.
body.zh:
Shelley 80 年代中锁死鼓。巅峰：Daydream Nation–Dirty 上的 Moore / Gordon / Ranaldo / Shelley。O'Rourke 后扩展纹理。

巅峰旗在 80 年代末四人。

title.zh: 双吉他噪音、Gordon 贝斯/人声

body.en:
Moore/Ranaldo: interlocking dissonance, amp stacks. Gordon: spoken-sung bass songs. Shelley: motorik-leaning indie kit.

Shoegaze bands later borrow the wall; SY keeps NYC art-punk diction.
body.zh:
Moore/Ranaldo：交错不协和、音箱堆。Gordon：说唱式贝斯歌。Shelley：偏 motorik 的 indie 鼓。

后来 shoegaze 乐队借墙；SY 保留纽约艺术朋克咬字。

title.en: Teen Age Riot: anthem from detune
title.zh: Teen Age Riot：来自另调的圣歌

body.en:
Daydream Nation. Open tuning shimmer, Moore vocal, long form without prog vanity.

Indie anthem built from noise tools.
body.zh:
Daydream Nation。开放调弦闪烁、Moore 人声、无 prog 虚荣的长曲式。

用噪音工具建成的 indie 圣歌。

body.en:
Goo. Gordon lead, hip-hop cameo, still detuned riffs. Proof noise method survives gloss.

1990 crossover face.
body.zh:
Goo。Gordon 主唱、嘻哈客串、仍是另调 riff。证明噪音方法扛得住抛光。

1990 跨界脸。

title.en: Noise method for alt and shoegaze
title.zh: 给 alt 与 shoegaze 的噪音方法

body.en:
Nirvana, MBV, and later indie cite tunings and feedback harmony. Genre graph keeps SY under alternative; narrative owns the noise/shoegaze adjacency.

NYC art-noise that taught radio to tolerate abrasion.
body.zh:
Nirvana、MBV 与后来 indie 引用调弦与反馈和声。类型图把 SY 留在 alternative；叙事承认噪音/shoegaze 相邻。

教电台忍受磨损的纽约艺术噪音。

note.zh: Sister 至 Dirty 巅峰窗。
Daydream Nation 上的另调弦圣歌。

note.en: Prepared/alternate guitar as indie composition; noise and shoegaze adjacency in method.
note.zh: 预制/另调吉他作为 indie 作曲；方法上与噪音和 shoegaze 相邻。
